variables.name: PORT
variables.description: HTTP port for the LaBass Technologies web server. Defaults to 8839.

variables.name: EGATE_API_KEY
variables.description: Private egate app key used to email consultation requests. Set this in server-side configuration.

variables.name: CONSULTATION_RECIPIENT_EMAIL
variables.description: Email address that receives consultation form submissions.

variables.name: EGATE_HOST
variables.description: Base URL of the email gateway. Defaults to https://egate.englandsoftware.com.
